protocol.scope: All eight scored TRAIN panels only. No validation/private labels.
protocol.labels: Threshold eligible released speed by public v_cut; observation proxy, not queue_true

source_snapshot.scope: Own source, vendored official Python and dependency locks; no data, credentials or model weights

source.peak_scope: current process lifetime, not isolated per model
source.source_fingerprint_scope: On-disk source at evidence() call; a captured start archive is primary when present

limitations: Only 80 early-June released TRAIN windows. Public thresholded observations are not the unreleased latent queue labels. Future coverage metadata is audited, never used as a forecast feature. Differences cannot identify hidden selector implementation or hidden labels.
